answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to publish a unique, continuous data stream peers check for copies. Each identity feeds the ledger a live, signed record of its work. Streams mirroring each other are flagged, and every copy loses standing, while jade-marked originals keep their weight. Like trees in an orchard, each identity must bear its own fruit; hollow copies yield nothing. A farm cannot run a hundred fakes on one pipeline: each extra fake needs its own independent, live source, a cost that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bought in bulk.
